summary: End-to-end validation of new batch: newsletter DB persistence + admin surface, Careers/Baseball/Camps pages, moving announcement bar, PDF links, admin subscribers tab/stat. Backend: 27/27 pytest passing (added 5 new newsletter tests + 1 stats.subscribers test). Frontend: all new pages render with expected data-testids and toast/dedupe flow works.

verified.admin_newsletter_auth: 401 without cookie, 403 for parent, 200 for admin, includes newly added emails
verified.footer_newsletter_form: sonner toast 'You're on the list!' on new, 'You're already on the list!' on dedupe
verified.announcement_bar: data-testid=announcement-bar visible at top on Home/Careers/Baseball/Camps/Contact
verified.baseball_page: /baseball renders 3 baseball-track-{i}, baseball-request-btn (QuoteRequestDialog), baseball-trial-btn (-> /contact); Baseball appears in Programs nav
verified.camps_page: /camps renders 9 camp-week-{i}, camp-registration-btn, camp-policies-btn, little-dog-signup-btn all linking to PDF URLs; little-dog-price shows '$120 MEMBERS / $130 NON-MEMBERS PER SESSION'
verified.admin_dashboard: 5 stat boxes including 'Email Subscribers' (8), Email List tab (admin-tab-subscribers) opens admin-subscribers-table with subscriber rows
verified.regression: Contact page + form still load; Home unchanged; auth/leads/contact/bookings/events tests all pass

critical_code_review_comments: Newsletter uniqueness enforced only via find_one race window; consider a unique index on newsletter_subscribers.email to make dedupe atomic under concurrency.
get_current_user still uses ObjectId(payload['sub']) inside try that only catches jwt exceptions; a malformed sub would raise InvalidId (bson) -> 500. Minor.
No rate limiting on /api/newsletter — susceptible to abuse. Consider IP throttling.

CORS uses samesite='none'+secure=True which is correct for cross-origin cookies, but FRONTEND_URL env not set will fall back to localhost:3000 only; production preview URL is not in allow_origins — currently only affects browser-origin XHR (works because request comes from same origin as preview). Safe today, worth documenting.
seed_data_creation: TEST_-prefixed newsletter subs and parent/lead/contact records added via pytest run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Newsletter emails are stored lowercased in DB (server lowercases before insert). Any test comparing must lower() the expected email. Admin stats now includes 'subscribers' key. Baseball trial CTA routes to /contact (iClassPro not integrated yet, per request).
